bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to tobacco products; permitting the sale of premium cigars from a movable place of business in certain circumstances; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 461.21.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 461.21, is amended to read:

461.21 KIOSK SALES PROHIBITED[+; EXCEPTION+].
[+(a) Except as provided in paragraph (b), +]no person shall sell tobacco, tobacco-related devices, or electronic delivery devices as defined in section 609.685, subdivision 1, or nicotine or lobelia delivery products as described in section 609.6855, from a movable place of business. For the purposes of this section, a movable place of business means any retail business whose physical location is not permanent, including, but not limited to, any retail business that is operated from a kiosk, other transportable structure, or a motorized or nonmotorized vehicle.

[+(b) A person with a distributor license issued under chapter 297F for at least five consecutive years may sell premium cigars from a movable place of business and provide on-site demonstrations of premium cigar manufacturing and cultural education from the movable place of business. A person authorized to sell and demonstrate under this paragraph: (1) is not required to obtain a separate license under chapter 297F for the movable place of business; (2) must pay all applicable taxes related to the movable place of business; and (3) must not sell any tobacco products other than premium cigars. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to tobacco products; permitting the sale of premium cigars from a movable place of business in certain circumstances; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 461.21.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 461.21, is amended to read:

461.21 KIOSK SALES PROHIBITED; EXCEPTION.
(a) Except as provided in paragraph (b), no person shall sell tobacco, tobacco-related devices, or electronic delivery devices as defined in section 609.685, subdivision 1, or nicotine or lobelia delivery products as described in section 609.6855, from a movable place of business. For the purposes of this section, a movable place of business means any retail business whose physical location is not permanent, including, but not limited to, any retail business that is operated from a kiosk, other transportable structure, or a motorized or nonmotorized vehicle.

(b) A person with a distributor license issued under chapter 297F for at least five consecutive years may sell premium cigars from a movable place of business and provide on-site demonstrations of premium cigar manufacturing and cultural education from the movable place of business. A person authorized to sell and demonstrate under this paragraph: (1) is not required to obtain a separate license under chapter 297F for the movable place of business; (2) must pay all applicable taxes related to the movable place of business; and (3) must not sell any tobacco products other than premium cigars.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (b) A person with a distributor license issued under chapter 297F for at least five consecutive years may sell premium cigars from a movable place of business and provide on-site demonstrations of premium cigar manufacturing and cultural education from the movable place of business. A person authorized to sell and demonstrate under this paragraph: (1) is not required to obtain a separate license under chapter 297F for the movable place of business; (2) must pay all applicable taxes related to the movable place of business; and (3) must not sell any tobacco products other than premium cigars.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
